slots.label: Percent means per hundred
entries: Percent means per hundred: shade twenty-five cells out of one hundred on the hundred-grid - that shaded amount is 25%.
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

slots.label: Watch out: 25% is not just 25
entries: Watch out: 25% is not just 25: the 25 counts out of one hundred, and the whole here is 60, so the answer is a share of 60, not 25 itself.
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

slots.label: 25% of 60: divide into quarters
entries: 25% of 60: divide into quarters: 25 out of 100 simplifies to one quarter, so split 60 into four equal parts and take one: 60 / 4 = 15.
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

slots.label: The takeaway
entries: The takeaway: a percent is out of one hundred - turn it into a fraction of the whole first, and 25% of 60 comes out as one quarter of 60, which is 15.
slots.studentPrompt: Explain this step in your own words.

slots.label: Percent
entries: A count out of one hundred: 25% is 25 out of 100, whatever the whole in the question is.
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

slots.label: Hundred-grid
entries: A square split into one hundred equal cells for picturing a percent: twenty-five shaded cells out of one hundred is 25%.
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

slots.label: One quarter
entries: One of four equal parts of a whole: 25 out of 100 simplifies to one quarter, so 25% of a quantity is a quarter of it.
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.

slots.label: Whole
entries: The full amount the percent is taken of: in 25% of 60 the whole is 60, so the answer is a share of 60.
slots.studentPrompt: Give your own example of this term.
